title: Ziff Davis to Participate in Two Investor Conferences in September
summary: Ziff Davis, Inc. (NASDAQ: ZD), today announced its participation in two investor conferences in September. Details of the conferences are as follows: 2026 Citi Global TMT Conference Location: New York, NY Date and time: September 9, 2026 Webcast: No formal presentation Benchmark-StoneX’s 13th Annual TMT Conference Location: New York, NY Date and time: September 17, 2026 Webcast: No formal presentation About Ziff Davis Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, health and wellness, cybersecurity, and martech. For more information, visit www.ziffdavis.com . Investor Relations Ziff Davis, Inc. investor@ziffdavis.com Corporate Communications Ziff Davis, Inc. press@ziffdavis.com Source: Ziff Davis, Inc.
